rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: بغوا means injustice: the wealthy wrong one another; wealth breeds insolence, as Qarun shows.
rows.anchor: {لبغوا } من البغي وهو الظلم

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet said worldly flourishing and abundance were what he most feared for his community.
rows.anchor: قوله عليه الصلاة والسلام : ( 994 ) ( أخوف ما أخاف على أمتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An Arab verse depicts people revived by rain who then conceived plans for transgression and rivalry.
rows.anchor: يعني : أنهم أحيوا فحدثوا أنفسهم بالبغي والتفانن

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Alternatively بغى means extravagance and pride, leading to arrogance, overreach, and corruption.
rows.anchor: أو من البغي وهو البذخ والكبر

rows.speaker: خباب ابن الأرت
rows.claim: Khabbab said it came down about people of the Suffa who coveted the wealth of Qurayza, Nadir, and Qaynuqa.
rows.anchor: قال خباب ابن الأرت : فينا نزلت ، وذلك أنا نظرنا إلى أموال بني قريظة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: بقدر means by measured apportionment; the verb takes either of two verbal nouns.
rows.anchor: بتقدير . يقال قدره قدرا وقدرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows how people's circumstances will turn out and apportions what best preserves their welfare by divine wisdom.
rows.anchor: يعرف ما يؤول إليه أحوالهم ، فيقدر لهم ما هو أصلح لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Poverty makes transgression less common and abundance more common; universal prosperity would make it predominate, answering why some poor people transgress and some rich people do not.
rows.anchor: لا شبهة في أن البغي مع الفقر أقل ومع البسط أكثر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He cites a poetic image of a fresh, pleasant drink like musk sprinkled over grape-water.
rows.anchor: لقد سقتني رضابا غير ذي أسن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paradisal milk never turns sour or develops an unpleasant taste as worldly milk does.
rows.anchor: كما تتغير ألبان الدنيا ، فلا يعود قارصا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: لذة is either the feminine of لذ, meaning delicious, or an adjective expressed by a verbal noun.
rows.anchor: تأنيث لذ ، وهو اللذيذ ، أو وصف بمصدر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: لذة is genitive as an adjective of wine, nominative as an adjective of rivers, or accusative to express the purpose of pleasing drinkers.
rows.anchor: وقرىء بالحركات الثلاث ، فالجر على صفة الخمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Its pleasure is pure, without loss of reason, hangover, headache, or other afflictions of worldly wine.
rows.anchor: ما هو إلا التلذذ الخالص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The honey is purified, with no wax or other material mixed in from the bees' combs.
rows.anchor: لم يخرج من بطون النحل فيخالطه الشمع وغيره

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: It is said that the boiling water scorches faces, separates scalps, and cuts intestines when drunk.
rows.anchor: إذا دنا منهم شوى وجوههم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are hypocrites who attend the Prophet's gathering but heed nothing out of disdain, then mockingly ask the knowledgeable Companions what he just said.
rows.anchor: كانوا يحضرون مجلس رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One account says that when the Prophet criticized hypocrites while preaching, they left and asked the scholars what he said.
rows.anchor: كان يخطب فإذا عاب المنافقين خرجوا

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another account identifies Abdullah ibn Masud as the person they asked.
rows.anchor: وقيل : قالوه لعبد الله بن مسعود

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas said he was among those addressed and had been named among those questioned.
rows.anchor: أنا منهم ، وقد سميت فيمن سئل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A variant reads أنفا on the pattern فعل, in the adverbial accusative.
rows.anchor: وقرىء : ( أنفا ) على فعل

rows.speaker: الزجاج
rows.claim: Al-Zajjaj derives it from استأنفت الشيء, meaning that I began something.
rows.anchor: هو من استأنفت الشيء : إذا ابتدأته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question means what he said at the first moment close to them.
rows.anchor: ماذا قال في أول وقت يقرب منا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An unattributed report says Salman served two Companions; when they sent him for a condiment and he returned empty-handed, they mocked him, and the Prophet identified their remark as backbiting before the verse was revealed.
rows.anchor: أن سلمان كان يخدم رجلين من الصحابة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The man and woman are Adam and Eve.
rows.anchor: من ذكر وأنثى } من آدم وحواء

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Alternatively every person is from a father and mother, so all have equal origins and none can claim superiority by lineage.
rows.anchor: خلقنا كل واحد منكم من أب وأم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Arab genealogy has six levels, shaʿb, tribe, ʿimara, batn, fakhidh, and family, illustrated by Khuzayma, Kinana, Quraysh, Qusay, Hashim, and al-Abbas.
rows.anchor: الطبقة الأولى من الطبقات الست التي عليها العرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Variants include لتتعارفوا with assimilation, لتعارفوا, لِتَعرفوا, and لتتعرفوا; one means learning how people are related.
rows.anchor: وقرىء : ( لتتعارفوا ) ولتعارفوا بالإدغام . ولتعرفوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The purpose of tribes and clans is for people to identify one another's ancestry, not to claim other fathers or boast in lineage.
rows.anchor: أن الحكمة التي من أجلها رتبكم على شعوب وقبائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Piety, not ancestry, is the trait by which a person gains honor and dignity with God.
rows.anchor: الخصلة التي بها يفضل الإنسان غيره ويكتسب الشرف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A variant reads أن with fatḥa, explaining that the most honored before God are the most pious, not the best-born.
rows.anchor: وقرىء : ( أن ) بالفتح ، كأنه قيل : لم لا يتفاخر

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: At Mecca's conquest, the Prophet said God removed pagan arrogance and people are either pious believers honored by God or wicked, wretched people low in His sight, then recited the verse.
rows.anchor: وعن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : ( 1079 ) أنه طاف يوم فتح مكة

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet said whoever wants to be the most honored of people should fear God.
rows.anchor: وعنه عليه السلام : ( 1080 ) ( من سره أن يكون أكرم الناس

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas distinguishes worldly nobility, which is wealth, from next-world nobility, which is piety.
rows.anchor: كرم الدنيا الغني ، وكرم الآخرة التقوى

rows.speaker: يزيد بن شجرة
rows.claim: Yazid ibn Shajara reports that the Prophet bought a Black boy who stipulated he not be kept from the five prayers behind him; after the boy fell ill and died, the Prophet visited, washed, and buried him, deeply affecting the Emigrants and Helpers, and the verse was revealed.
rows.anchor: وعو يزيد بن شجرة : ( 1081 ) مر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في سوق المدينة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: عيي بالأمر means being unable to find a way to do something; the opening hamza is interrogative for denial.
rows.anchor: عيي بالأمر : إذا لم يهتد لوجه عمله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God was not incapable of first creation, as they know, so He cannot be incapable of recreating people.
rows.anchor: أنا لم نعجز كما علموا عن الخلق الأول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are caught in confusion because Satan has confused and bewildered them.
rows.anchor: في خلط وشبهة . قد لبس عليهم الشيطان وحيرهم

rows.speaker: علي رضي الله عنه
rows.claim: Ali told al-Harith he was confused and should recognize the truth to recognize its people.
rows.anchor: قول علي رضي الله عنه : يا حار ، إنه لملبوس عليك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan made resurrection seem contrary to custom, leading them to abandon the sound inference that whoever originated creation can restore it even more readily.
rows.anchor: تسويله إليهم أن إحياء الموتى أمر خارج عن العادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The indefinite خلق جديد signals a momentous new creation whose gravity should prompt attention, fear, and inquiry.
rows.anchor: قصد في تنكيره إلى خلق جديد له شأن عظيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling angels daughters gives each angel a feminine name.
rows.anchor: أي كل واحد منهم { تسمية الانثى } لأنهم إذا قالوا

rows.speaker: أبي
rows.claim: Ubayy reads بها, referring either to the angels or the act of naming.
rows.anchor: وفي قراءة أبي : ( بها ) ، أي : بالملائكة .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Truth, meaning what a thing really is, is grasped through knowledge and certainty, not conjecture and imagining.
rows.anchor: يعني إنما يدرك الحق الذي هو حقيقة الشيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turn away from whoever rejects God's remembrance and the afterlife and wants only worldly life; do not exhaust yourself trying to secure his conversion.
rows.anchor: عن دعوة من رأيته معرضا عن ذكر الله وعن الآخرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows who responds; the Prophet cannot guide whom he loves, and his duty is only to convey the message.
rows.anchor: إنما يعلم الله من يجيب ممن لا يجيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ذلك مبلغهم من العلم is parenthetical or attached to the command to turn away; God knows the misguided and guided and will repay each as deserved.
rows.anchor: اعتراض أو فأعرض عنه ولا تقابله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أكدى means he stopped giving, from a digger stopping at hard rock; by analogy a poet runs out of words.
rows.anchor: قطع عطيته وأمسك ، وأصله : إكداء الحافر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says Uthman gave freely until his foster-brother warned him he would soon be poor and offered to bear his sins for Uthman's camel; Uthman gave it, witnessed the deal, stopped giving, and the verse was revealed.
rows.anchor: روى : ( 1104 ) أن عثمان رضي الله عنه كان يعطي ما له في الخير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning away means leaving one's position at Uhud; Uthman later returned to better conduct.
rows.anchor: ومعنى { تولى } ترك المركز يوم أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He knows his brother's promise to bear all his sins is true.
rows.anchor: فهو يعلم أن ما قاله له أخوه من احتمال أو زاره حق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: وفى is read light or doubled; doubling intensifies fulfillment or means fully completed.
rows.anchor: قرىء مخففا ومشددا ، والتشديد مبالغة في الوفاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Its general wording covers conveying the message, carrying prophetic burdens, enduring the intended sacrifice and Nimrod's fire, and serving guests personally.
rows.anchor: وإطلاقه ليتناول كل وفاء وتوفية ، من ذلك : تبليغه الرسالة

rows.speaker: الحسن
rows.claim: Al-Hasan said Abraham fulfilled every command from God.
rows.anchor: وعن الحسن : ما أمره الله بشيء إلا وفى به

rows.speaker: الهذيل بن شرحبيل
rows.claim: Al-Hudhayl says people between Noah and Abraham bore others' crimes; Abraham first opposed this.
rows.anchor: بين نوح وبين إبراهيم يؤخذ الرجل بجريرة

rows.speaker: عطاء بن السائب
rows.claim: Ata ibn al-Saib says Abraham vowed never to ask a created being; in the fire he told Gabriel and Michael he had no need of them.
rows.anchor: وعن عطاء بن السائب : عهد أن لا يسأل مخلوقا

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet said Abraham fulfilled his work with four rakas each day in the early morning, the Duha prayer.
rows.anchor: وعن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : ( 1105 ) وفى عمله كل يوم بأربع ركعات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report asks why God called Abraham His intimate friend the one who fulfilled; he recited morning and evening glorifications from 30:17–18.
rows.anchor: ألا أخبركم لم سمى الله خليله { الذى وفى } ؟ كان يقول

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another explanation says Abraham fulfilled thirty shares of Islam, ten each from the Repentance, Ahzab, and Believers passages.
rows.anchor: وقيل : وفي سهام الإسلام : وهي ثلاثون : عشرة في التوبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: صحف is also read with a light consonant.
rows.anchor: وقرىء : ( في صحف ) ، بالتخفيف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أن is a lightened heavy particle, meaning no bearer bears another's burden; its clause is genitive as a substitute for ما or nominative as the predicate of an implied هو.
rows.anchor: أن مخففة من الثقيلة . والمعنى : أنه لا تزر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إلا ما سعى means only a person's own effort.
rows.anchor: إلا ما سعى } إلا سعيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another's effort helps only when based on the deceased's own faith and good conduct, making it effectively their effort.
rows.anchor: أحدهما : أن سعى غيره لما لم ينفعه إلا مبنيا على سعي نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His second answer is that another's deed does not benefit if done for oneself, but if intended for the deceased sacred law treats the performer as their agent.
rows.anchor: والثاني ؛ أن سعي غيره لا ينفعه إذا عمله لنفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant is repaid for his effort; جزاه الله عمله can omit the preposition, or the pronoun can refer to the reward explained by الجزاء الأوفى.
rows.anchor: ثم يجزى العبد سعيه ، يقال : جزاه الله عمله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He compares the wording to 21:3, وأسروا النجوى الذين ظلموا.
rows.anchor: أو أبدله عنه ، كقوله تعالى : { وأسروا النجوى الذين ظلموا }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Read with fatḥa it says all this is in the scriptures; read with kasra it begins a new sentence, as with what follows.
rows.anchor: قرىء بالفتح على معنى : أن هذا كله في الصحف ، وبالكسر على الابتداء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: المنتهى means the end: creation ends with God and returns to Him, as in 35:18.
rows.anchor: والمنتهى : مصدر بمعنى الانتهاء ، أي : ينتهي إليه الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God creates the powers of laughter and crying.
rows.anchor: أضحك وأبكى } خلق قوتي الضحك والبكاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إذا تمنى means when semen flows into the womb; the verbs are used as منى and أمنى.
rows.anchor: إذا تدفق في الرحم ، يقال : منى وأمنى

rows.speaker: الأخفش
rows.claim: Al-Akhfash derives it from منى الماني, the measurer, meaning the determiner determined it.
rows.anchor: وعن الأخفش : تخلق من منى الماني ، أي قدر المقدر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: النشأة is also read النشاءة with a long vowel.
rows.anchor: قرىء : ( النشأة ) النشاءة بالمد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The next creation is incumbent on God by wisdom so that good and evil can be recompensed.
rows.anchor: ليجازى على الإحسان والإساءة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أقنى means God gave acquired wealth intended to be retained and not relinquished.
rows.anchor: وأعطى القنية وهي المال الذي تأثلته وعزمت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The star intended is al-Ubur, behind Gemini; Khuzaa worshipped it after Abu Kabsha established the custom, and Quraysh likened the Prophet to him for opposing their religion.
rows.anchor: مرزم الجوزاء : وهي التي تطلع وراءها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: عاد الأولى refers to Hud's people; the later Ad is Iram.
rows.anchor: عاد الأولى : قوم هود ، وعاد الأخرى : إرم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Others take الأولى to mean the ancients, first nation destroyed after Noah, or those eminent in worldly life.
rows.anchor: وقيل : الأولى القدماء ؛ لأنهم أول الأمم هلاكا بعد قوم نوح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Variants عاد لولي and عاد لولى assimilate nunation into lam, omit the hamza of أولى, and move its vowel to the article.
rows.anchor: وقرىء : ( عاد لولي ) وعاد لولى ، بإدغام التنوين في اللام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Thamud is read with final accusative alif or without it.
rows.anchor: وثمودا ) وقرىء : وثمود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah's people beat him until he could not move, fled from him, and warned their children not to hear him, while his preaching affected them for nearly a thousand years.
rows.anchor: لأنهم كانوا يؤذونه ويضربونه حتى لا يكون به حراك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: المؤتفكة means Lot's settlements overturned with their inhabitants; أفكه فائتفك means to overturn.
rows.anchor: والقرى التي ائتفكت بأهلها ، أي : انقلبت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The expression is also read in the plural as والمؤتفكات.
rows.anchor: وقرىء : ( والمؤتفكات )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gabriel lifted the settlements toward the sky on his wing, then dropped them to earth.
rows.anchor: ثم أهواها إلى الأرض أي : أسقطها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase magnifies the punishment poured on the towns, including a rain of stones laid one upon another.
rows.anchor: تهويل وتعظيم لما صب عليها من العذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sky becomes red like oil grease or dregs; دهان can mean oil collectively or a greasing substance.
rows.anchor: وردة } حمراء { كالدهان } كدهن الزيت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An anonymous poem compares waterskins to full ones greased with oil.
rows.anchor: كأنهما مزادتا متعجل … فريان لما تدهنا بدهان

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another explanation takes دهان to mean red leather.
rows.anchor: وقيل : الدهان الأديم الأحمر

rows.speaker: عمرو بن عبيد
rows.claim: Amr ibn Ubayd reads وردة in the nominative, making the sky rose-colored; this is called tajrid.
rows.anchor: وقرأ عمرو بن عبيد ( وردة ) بالرفع ، بمعنى : فحصلت سماء وردة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إنس means some humans and جان means some jinn; the ancestor's name is used for descendants, and the singular pronoun reflects the meaning some of humankind.
rows.anchor: إنس } بعض من الإنس { ولا جان } أريد به : ولا جن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are not asked because their marks identify them as criminals: black faces and blue eyes.
rows.anchor: وإنما وحد ضمير الإنس في قوله : { عن ذنبه } لكونه في معنى البعض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although 15:92 and 37:24 say people will be questioned, the Day has different stations where they are or are not asked.
rows.anchor: فإن قلت : هذا خلاف قوله تعالى : { فوربك لنسئلنهم أجمعين }

rows.speaker: قتادة
rows.claim: Qatada says questioning occurred, then mouths were sealed and hands and feet spoke about people's deeds.
rows.anchor: قال قتادة : قد كانت مسألة ، ثم ختم على أفواه القوم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view says they are not asked to discover their sins, but are questioned in reproach.
rows.anchor: وقيل لا يسأل عن ذنبه ليعلم من جهته

rows.speaker: الحسن وعمرو بن عبيد
rows.claim: Al-Hasan and Amr ibn Ubayd read ولا جأن with an added alif to avoid adjacent vowelless letters.
rows.anchor: وقرأ الحسن وعمرو بن عبيد ( ولا جأن ) فرارا من التقاء الساكنين

rows.speaker: الضحاك
rows.claim: Al-Dahhak says the forelock and foot are joined in a chain behind the criminal's back.
rows.anchor: عن الضحاك : يجمع بين ناصيته وقدمه

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view says angels drag criminals, alternately seizing them by forelocks and feet.
rows.anchor: تسحبهم الملائكة : تارة تأخذ بالنواصي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: حميم آن is water whose heat has reached its limit; punishment alternates between fire and drinking it.
rows.anchor: حميم ءان } ماء حار قد انتهى حره ونضجه

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One view says when they plead for rescue from fire, the boiling water is made their rescue.
rows.anchor: وقيل : إذا استغاثوا من النار جعل غياثهم الحميم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view describes a valley where the inmates' pus gathers; they are taken in chains, immersed until their joints come apart, and brought out with new creation.
rows.anchor: وقيل : إن واديا من أودية جهنم يجتمع فيه صديد أهل النار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading is causative, while another means going around or being led around between punishments.
rows.anchor: وقرىء : ( يطوفون ) من التطويف . ويطوفون

words: هذه جهنم التي يكذب بها المجرمون
rows.speaker: عبد الله
rows.claim: Abdullah's reading expands the address to say this is the Hell they both denied, where they burn, neither dying nor living, and move between punishments.
rows.anchor: وفي قراءة عبد الله : ( هذه جهنم التي كنتما بها تكذبان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessing in describing this terror is rescue by God's mercy and grace; warning of it is itself a kindness.
rows.anchor: ونعمة الله فيما ذكره من هول العذاب : نجاة الناجي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Event is the Resurrection, called an occurrence because it will certainly happen; وقع means something descended or came to pass.
rows.anchor: كقولك : كانت الكائنة ، وحدثت الحادثة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إذا is governed by ليس, an omitted verb meaning such-and-such will happen, or an implied command to remember.
rows.anchor: فإن قلت : بم انتصب إذا ؟ قلت : بليس . كقولك يوم الجمعة ليس لي شغل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One view says no soul will deny God or the unseen then: all will believe truly, unlike people now who deny until punishment appears.
rows.anchor: أي : لا تكون حين تقع نفس تكذب على الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively no soul will deny the Event or tell itself that it will never happen, as many do now.
rows.anchor: أو : ليس لها نفس تكذبها وتقول لها : لم تكوني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another sense is self-encouragement in a terrible trial; then people will be too weak to reassure themselves that they can endure it, like scattered moths.
rows.anchor: أو هي من قولهم : كذبت فلانا نفسه في الخطب العظيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively كاذبة is a verbal noun meaning denial or cowardice, as in حمل على قرنه فما كذب; Zuhayr's line witnesses this usage.
rows.anchor: وقيل : { كاذبة } مصدر كالعاقبة بمعنى التكذيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The foremost are the sincere who hastened to answer God's call and raised dust seeking His pleasure.
rows.anchor: المخلصون الذين سبقوا إلى ما دعاهم الله إليه وشقوا الغبار

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One account makes the early, persistent doers of good the foremost brought near; late repenters the people of the right; and those who persist in youthful evil the people of the left.
rows.anchor: وقيل : الناس ثلاثة فرجل ابتكر الخير في حداثة سنه ، ثم داوم عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The repeated questions express wonder at the groups' happiness and misery: what manner of people are they?
rows.anchor: تعجيب من حال الفريقين في السعادة والشقاوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The repetition means the foremost whose standing and description already reached the listener, and serves as emphasis.
rows.anchor: يريد : والسابقون من عرفت حالهم وبلغك وصفهم

rows.speaker: أبو النجم
rows.claim: Abu al-Najm's وشعري شعري illustrates the construction: poetry already known for eloquence and excellence.
rows.anchor: وقول أبي النجم : وشعري شعري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أولئك المقربون is the predicate; the sound pause is after the second السابقون, completing the clause in parallel with the other groups.
rows.anchor: ووقف بعضهم على : والسابقون ؛ وابتدأ السابقون أولئك المقربون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The brought-near have elevated ranks in Paradise close to the Throne.
rows.anchor: الذين قربت درجاتهم في الجنة من العرش وأعليت مراتبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading has في جنة النعيم.
rows.anchor: وقرىء : ( في جنة النعيم )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: الثلة means a large group; a poetic line using it is cited as evidence.
rows.anchor: والثلة : الأمة من الناس الكثيرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: يبدله is read with a light consonant or doubled for intensification or multiplicity.
rows.anchor: قرىء : ( يبدله ) ، بالتخفيف والتشديد للكثرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مسلمات مؤمنات describes women who submit and believe sincerely.
rows.anchor: { مسلمات مؤمنات } مقرات مخلصات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: سائحات means fasting women; سيحات is more emphatic, likening restraint until iftar to a traveler without provisions waiting for food.
rows.anchor: { سائحات } صائمات . وقرىء : ( سيحات ) ، وهي أبلغ

rows.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
rows.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam says there was no religious touring in this community except migration.
rows.anchor: وعن زيد بن أسلم : لم تكن في هذه الأمة سياحة إلى الهجرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Though no earthly women were better than the Mothers of the Believers, divorce for disobedience and harm would remove that standing; replacements obedient to the Prophet could then be better.
rows.anchor: قلت : إذا طلقهن رسول الله لعصيانهن له وإيذائهن إياه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: قانتات hints at obedience to the Prophet, since qunut is obedience to God and obedience to God includes obeying His Messenger.
rows.anchor: وقد عرض بذلك في قوله : { قانتات } لأن القنوت هو القيام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The descriptions lack conjunctions except between previously married women and virgins because these two states cannot coexist in one person.
rows.anchor: لأنهما صفتان متنافيتان لا يجتمعن فيهما اجتماعهن في سائر الصفات
